def get_processed_ast(
    source: str,
    ast_obj: Module,
    context_list: List[int],
    guard_list: List[int],
) -> Module:
    """Get processed AST."""

    processed_ast = deepcopy(ast_obj)

    for i, node in enumerate(processed_ast.body):
        if is_valid_node(node, source, context_list, guard_list):
            continue

        if isinstance(node, Class):
            continue

        processed_ast.body[i] = processed_ast.body[i].as_string()

    return processed_ast
